title: Outcome of ICSI Using Cryopreserved Testicular Sperm From Infertile Men With Varicocele-associated Azoospermia
brief_summary: This study will include cryopreserved sperm from infertile azoospermic men, with proven diagnosis of varicocele (clinical \& sonographic), which will be used for ICSI in an ART program in Sohag. Patients personal and medical history and socio-demographic data will be retrieved from their saved medical files.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* cryopreserved sperm from infertile azoospermic men, with proven diagnosis of varicocele (clinical \& sonographic), which will be used for ICSI in aى ART program.
* ICSI cases using cryopreserved sperms from infertile azoospermic men due to etiologies other than varicocele.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cases with known female factor infertility
